title: tier-2 shipped code: the four-lane record applier at 0x140cb3b10
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is `crates/ow-sim/src/modifiers.rs` (`apply_vector_records`), called through the `mover_vector_records` entry.

`FUN_140cb3b10` walks the 0x40-byte records at `body+0x960` (count `+0x968`), keeps those whose window `[+0x1c,+0x20)` holds the frame id `body+0xe4` and whose `+0x28` equals the caller's mode, and applies the op at `+0x2c` to the four-lane quad at `+0x30`. With mode 1 the y lane is restored to the value it held before each record.

The oracle reads the records from the arena address in `body+0x960`; the candidate receives the same bytes as its fourth argument. The quad is a 16-byte `float*` on both sides, so the mutated quad is the second channel.
Cases cross the five ops with NaN, infinite, zero and equal-length quads, the window and mode edges, several matching records in table order, and both mode values for the y-lane restore.
acknowledgedGaps: The record producer is not covered here; the fixture builds the array itself (open, `docs/open-questions.md`).
This leaf is not called from the jump function: it is the applier for `body+0x960`, the table the per-frame velocity resolve reads.
